text:
Situation: Granisetron hydrochloride 1 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 204 tablets (26.8 days on hand at 7.6 tablets daily). Corvale General holds 135 tablets (14.9 days on hand at 9.1 tablets daily).

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 69452035001 identifies OrBion Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (FEI 3004540907) as the manufacturing plant. FDA last inspected that plant on 2025-10-27 and classified it NAI. FDA records show four prior inspections classified VAI, with the most recent ending 2023-09-08 and known to FDA on 2023-10-11. FDA's shortage list does not include this drug.

Our position: Current inventory covers projected use for 15 to 27 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate manufacturers are available but their plant locations are not verifiable from labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to check current inventory against projected use and confirm availability from Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. before placing orders. Requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Natco Pharma Limited as a secondary source if Breckenridge supply is insufficient. Requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to review days-on-hand thresholds and set reorder points for both sites. Requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
